_note: Expected values are computed BY HAND from game.contract.json (v1.1) and Ticket-02 (see docs/notes/phase2-assumptions.md). Never paste them from game output. Events named night_start are ignored unless expect.keep_night_start.

cases.name: pickup_mote
cases.why: Mote 0.5 m away is picked on tick 1; pickup gives no points now (+10 is per mote deposited).

cases.name: pickup_height_tolerance
cases.why: XZ in range: mote 1.4 m above the feet is picked (<= 1.5), mote 1.6 m above is not.

cases.name: pickup_xz_radius
cases.why: A mote exactly 1.0 m away is picked (<= 1.0); 1.01 m is not.

cases.name: pickup_capacity_10
cases.why: carried = capacity (10): a mote in range is ignored.

cases.name: mote_initial_20_distinct
cases.why: Night 1 starts with 20 random fireflies on 20 different points.

cases.name: mote_spawn_schedule
cases.why: One firefly is added at ticks 240, 480 (20 -> 21 -> 22).

cases.name: mote_cap_30
cases.why: With 30 fireflies on the ground no more are spawned at tick 240/480.

cases.name: dropped_mote_ttl
cases.why: A dropped mote with ttl 3 ticks exists at tick 3 and is gone at tick 4.

cases.name: deposit_and_light
cases.why: Carrying 10 = lantern_cost next to L1 (0,0,25): interact on tick 2 deposits 10 and lights it. Score 10*10 + 100 = 200.

cases.name: deposit_remembers_progress
cases.why: Deposit 3, walk and pick 7 more (tick 18), deposit 7: lantern remembers progress (3+7=10) and lights. Score 30+70+100 = 200.

cases.name: deposit_out_of_range
cases.why: 5 m from L1 (> 2.0): interact does nothing.

cases.name: deposit_tie_smaller_id
cases.why: L1 and L2 equally near (1.5 m): the smaller id (L1) gets the deposit.

cases.name: deposit_nearest
cases.why: L3 is nearest (1.0 m) among three lanterns in range: it gets the deposit.

cases.name: deposit_skips_lit_lanterns
cases.why: Only unlit lanterns are considered: lit L1 (1.0 m) is skipped, unlit L2 (1.9 m) gets the deposit.

cases.name: win_all_lit
cases.why: L2..L5 pre-lit (no points). Lighting L1 on tick 1: 100 (10 motes) + 100 (lantern) + 2*floor(99.98)=198 + 50*3 flames = 548.

cases.name: win_on_timeout_tick
cases.why: All lit on exactly the last tick (time_left 0.05 s = 3 ticks) is still a win: 100+100+2*0+150 = 350.

cases.name: prelit_all_wins_without_points
cases.why: All 5 lanterns pre-lit: win on tick 1, no lantern points: 2*floor(299.98)=598 + 150 = 748.

cases.name: dawn_loss
cases.why: time_left_s 0.05 = 3 ticks, nothing lit: lost / dawn at tick 3.

cases.name: no_flames_beats_dawn
cases.why: Last flame lost on the very tick time runs out: reason is no_flames, not dawn.

cases.name: shade_hits_until_lost
cases.why: Shade 0.5 m away, carry 4. Hit tick 1: flames 2, drop floor(4/2)=2 (ring 1.5-2.5, ttl 480). Invuln 90 ticks, shade recoils 2 m (state recoil) then chases back: hit tick 91 (carry 2, drop 1), tick 181 (carry 1, drop 0) -> no_flames.

cases.name: invulnerability_from_scenario
cases.why: invuln_ticks 100: the adjacent shade cannot hit before tick 100 (counter reaches 0 then).

cases.name: shade_hit_only_once_per_tick
cases.why: Two shades touching at once: only one flame is lost that tick.

cases.name: shade_states_detect_and_lose
cases.why: wander at 11 m -> chase (<=12, moves 4/60 toward Mây: 10.933); wander at 13 m stays wander; chase at 19 m -> wander (>18).

cases.name: shade_speed_night1
cases.why: Night 1 shade speed 4.0 m/s: 10 ticks toward Mây = 0.667 m (10 -> 9.333).

cases.name: shade_speed_night3
cases.why: Night 3 shade speed 4.5 m/s: 10 ticks = 0.75 m (10 -> 9.25).

cases.name: shade_schedule_night1
cases.why: Night 1: 2 shades at tick 300 (state spawning, then wander at tick 330), then 1 every 480 ticks (tick 780).

cases.name: shade_schedule_night2
cases.why: Night 2: 2 shades at tick 300, then every 420 ticks (720).

cases.name: shade_schedule_night3
cases.why: Night 3: 2 shades at tick 300, then every 360 ticks (660).

cases.name: shade_cap_night1
cases.why: Night 1 max 6 shades: spawns at 300,300,780,1260,1740,2220 and none at 2700.

cases.name: shade_spawn_keeps_15m_from_player
cases.why: Player standing at (37,0) next to spawn points at 15 deg and -15 deg: spawned shades are >= 15 m from Mây.

cases.name: safe_zone_blocks_shade
cases.why: L1 (0,0,25) lit, Mây standing on it: a shade coming from z=35 is stopped at the 6 m edge: z = 31.

cases.name: safe_zone_ejects_and_is_harmless
cases.why: Lighting L1 while a shade sits 0.5 m from it (and from Mây): no hit for 30+ ticks, shade pushed evenly to the 6 m edge: at tick 29 z = 25 - (0.5 + 5.5*29/30) = 19.183.

cases.name: pulse_3d_range_and_score
cases.why: Pulse centre = feet+0.8, 3D radius 5: A (3 m) and E (2.83 m) are stunned, D at XZ=5 is 5.009 m in 3D (out), B (10 m) out. +5 each = 10.

cases.name: pulse_radius_boundary
cases.why: Shade at XZ 4.9 m (3D distance 4.909 from the pulse centre at feet+0.8) is inside the 5 m radius and is stunned.

cases.name: pulse_push_and_stun_timing
cases.why: A at 3 m: pushed 4 m in 15 ticks (x=7 at tick 15), still stunned at tick 120, chasing at tick 135 (x = 7 - 15*0.0667 = 6). pulse_cd_s at tick 15 = (180-14)/60 = 2.767.

cases.name: pulse_refreshes_stun
cases.why: A already stunned (50 ticks left) is stunned again for 120 ticks, pushed 4 m and scores +5 again: still stunned at tick 100, x=7.

cases.name: pulse_needs_3_motes
cases.why: carried 2 < pulse_cost 3: pulse does not activate (no event, nothing spent, shade not stunned).

cases.name: pulse_cooldown
cases.why: Carry 9. Pulse at tick 0 (cost 3, event 1); pulse at tick 10 is inside the 180-tick cooldown and ignored; pulse at tick 180 (event 181) works. carried 6 at tick 100, 3 at tick 200.

cases.name: move_accel_and_camera_yaw
cases.why: Tick 1 speed 1 m/s (full speed 6 m/s after 6 ticks); move [1,0] with yaw 90 deg walks toward -z.

cases.name: move_diagonal_normalized
cases.why: move [1,1] is normalised: 0.75 m along (0.707,0.707) after 10 ticks = (0.53, 0, 0.53).

cases.name: jump_and_no_double_jump
cases.why: Tick 1: vy = 7 - 20/60 = 6.667, y = 0.111. A second press in mid-air is ignored: y at tick 3 = (21-2)/60 = 0.317. Back on the ground by tick 60.

cases.name: dash_distance_and_cooldown
cases.why: Dash +Z for 12 ticks at 14 m/s = 2.8 m (tick 12); cooldown 90 ticks from start: (90-11)/60 = 1.317 s left at tick 12; then slides to a stop at 3.05.

cases.name: dash_rules
cases.why: Dash at tick 0 (event 1); press during dash (tick 5) ignored; press at tick 50 inside cooldown ignored; press at tick 90 (event 91) allowed.

cases.name: dash_uses_input_direction
cases.why: Dash with move [1,0] goes along +x (not the facing +z): (2.8,0,0) at tick 12.

cases.name: dash_in_air_keeps_height
cases.why: Jump at tick 0, dash at tick 5: height stays y=0.5 for the whole dash (ticks 6-17), z advances 2.8.

cases.name: fall_off_island
cases.why: Walking off the Night 1 edge (r=40) at tick 13, free fall reaches Y<-10 at tick 72: -1 flame, all 5 motes lost. 60 ticks later (132) respawn at (0,0,0), invulnerable.

cases.name: fall_ignores_invulnerability
cases.why: Same fall while invulnerable (1000 ticks): the fall still costs a flame.

cases.name: fall_last_flame_loses
cases.why: Falling with 1 flame: player_hit has lost=true, game over no_flames on that tick, no respawn.

cases.name: island_edge_is_inclusive
cases.why: Standing exactly on r=40 does not fall.

cases.name: night2_bridge_walkable
cases.why: Walking along the bamboo bridge (x 30 -> 39.75, z=0) does not fall.

cases.name: night2_bridge_has_no_rail
cases.why: Walking sideways off the bridge (|z|>2) at tick 23: free fall, fall event at tick 82.

cases.name: pad_night2_lands_on_island_b
cases.why: Pad (20,0,18): launch vy 14, 24 m/s toward B's centre; movement keys (here -x) do not override. Tick 40: vel (22.581, 0.667, -8.129). Lands inside island B, on the ground.

cases.name: pad_night3_lands_on_tier2
cases.why: Pad (0,3,13): vy 12, 8 m/s toward -z; lands on the 6 m disc at tick 49 (z=6.467), then slides to a stop at (0,6,6).

cases.name: night3_inner_wall_blocks
cases.why: Walking from (0,0,-20) toward the 6 m disc (r<=8): the vertical wall stops Mây just outside r=8 (z in [-8.1,-8]).

cases.name: night3_ring_wall_blocks
cases.why: From (0,0,30) toward the ring (r<=24, z>0, Y=3): the wall stops Mây at z in [24, 24.1], y=0.

cases.name: night3_ramp_climb
cases.why: Ramp at 30 deg: from r=31 walking inward, tick 40 at r=27.25 the height is 3*(30-27.25)/6 = 1.375; at tick 150 Mây stands on the ring at y=3.

cases.name: night3_step_off_ledge_falls_to_lower_tier
cases.why: Walking off the outer edge of the ring (r>24) drops Mây to tier 0 (y=0) without a fall penalty.

cases.name: night3_bell_tower_blocks
cases.why: On the 6 m disc, walking toward the centre is stopped by the tower (r=2): z in [2, 2.1], y=6.

cases.name: night3_wind_pushes
cases.why: Night 3 wind: active from tick 1800 for 300 ticks (not at 1500 or 2100); between tick 1800 and 2100 (299 pushes) a still Mây is moved 299*2/60 = 9.967 m along dir_deg.

cases.name: night3_wind_disabled_flag
cases.why: wind_enabled=false: no wind, Mây does not move.

cases.name: night2_has_no_wind
cases.why: Night 2 has no wind at tick 1800.

cases.name: drifter_steals_3_and_flees
cases.why: Chasing drifter 2 m away, Mây carries 5: touches (<=1.2 m) at tick 7, steals min(3,5)=3, flees 240 ticks, removed at tick 247 (keeps stolen=3).

cases.name: drifter_detect_rules
cases.why: carried 5: idle at 10 m -> chase; idle at 20 m stays idle; chase at 16 m (>15) -> idle.

cases.name: drifter_needs_5_motes
cases.why: carried 4 (<5): drifter at 10 m stays idle.

cases.name: pulse_makes_chasing_drifter_flee
cases.why: Pulse on a chasing drifter: it flees without stealing (stolen 0), no score for it.

cases.name: pulse_makes_fleeing_drifter_drop_loot
cases.why: Pulse on a fleeing drifter carrying 3: drifter_drop(3) and 3 dropped fireflies (ttl 120 ticks = 2 s) appear where it was.

cases.name: drifter_schedule_night2
cases.why: Night 2: drifters appear at ticks 1200 and 2400 (D1 then D2), at most 2 alive (still 2 at 3600). Idle when Mây carries nothing.

cases.name: no_drifters_night1
cases.why: Night 1 has no drifters.

cases.name: charm_pickup
cases.why: Charm 0.5 m away is picked on tick 1: charm_s = 600/60 = 10, charm unavailable with respawn 2700/60 = 45 s.

cases.name: charm_respawn_timer
cases.why: A charm with respawn_ticks 5 becomes available again at tick 5 (and is picked at once because Mây stands next to it).

cases.name: charm_speed_7_2
cases.why: With charm: speed 7.2 m/s (full after 6 ticks), 10 ticks = (1.2*21 + 4*7.2)/60 = 0.9 m.

cases.name: charm_expires
cases.why: charm_ticks 600: 1 tick left at tick 599 (0.017 s), over at tick 600.

cases.name: charm_dash_has_no_cooldown
cases.why: With charm, a second dash 20 ticks after the first (cooldown would be 90) is allowed; dash_cd_s stays 0.

cases.name: pause_freezes_logic
cases.why: Pause at tick 11 (paused), resume at tick 31. While paused tick advances but sim_tick (10), time and position (z=0.75) stay; snapshot state paused. After resume sim_tick 11, z=0.85.

cases.name: night1_map
cases.why: Night 1: 5 lanterns at the ticket coordinates, start (0,0,0), 300 s, 20 fireflies, nothing else, night_start event on tick 1.

cases.name: night2_map
cases.why: Night 2: 6 lanterns (two islands), 330 s, charm C1 at (35,0,0), night_start {night:2}.

cases.name: night3_map
cases.why: Night 3: 7 lanterns on three tiers, 360 s, charms C1 (30,0,25) and C2 (-30,0,25), start (0,0,-20).

cases.why: --night 4 is invalid

cases.why: Unknown drifter state name

cases.why: pause must be boolean

cases.why: Frame ticks must strictly increase.

cases.name: cli_bad_inputs_move_range
cases.why: move components must be in [-1,1].

cases.name: cli_inputs_not_json
cases.why: Malformed JSON.

cases.name: cli_scenario_unknown_lantern
cases.why: Unknown lantern id.

cases.name: cli_scenario_night1_has_no_L6
cases.why: L6 does not exist in Night 1.

cases.name: cli_scenario_wrong_type
cases.why: player.carried must be a non-negative integer.

cases.name: cli_missing_out
cases.why: --out is required.

cases.name: cli_scenario_file_missing
cases.why: Scenario path does not exist.
